service.name: CameraControlService
service.description: Kanaha Camera Control Service — remote camera control via HTTP/2 JSON-RPC and MCP (Model Context Protocol). Enables AI assistants to discover and control Android cameras with mTLS security and frame-accurate multi-camera synchronization.

operation.name: getStatus
operation.parameter: Get camera status: battery level, available storage, GPS timestamp and accuracy, current recording state, device model, and Android version. Use this to check if the camera is ready before starting operations.

operation.name: startRecording
operation.parameter: Start video recording. Supports scheduled start via start_at for frame-accurate multi-camera sync, and open gate recording (full 4:3 sensor) on compatible devices.

{"type":"object","properties":{"clip_name":{"type":"string","description":"Clip name. Default: default_clip"},"quality":{"type":"string","description":"4K, 1080p, 720p. Default: 4K"},"duration":{"type":"integer","description":"Max duration seconds. Default: 1800"},"format":{"type":"string","description":"MP4, MKV. Default: MP4"},"start_at":{"type":"integer","description":"UTC epoch ms for scheduled start. 0=now"},"open_gate":{"type":"boolean","description":"Full 4:3 sensor (Pixel 9 Pro). Default: false"}},"required":[]}

operation.name: stopRecording
operation.parameter: Stop the current video recording immediately.

operation.name: playTone
operation.parameter: Play a sync slate tone through the phone speaker. For multi-camera alignment — all cameras play at the same scheduled time. Post-processing detects waveform onset to ±1-5ms accuracy.

{"type":"object","properties":{"frequency":{"type":"integer","description":"Tone frequency Hz. Default: 1000"},"duration_ms":{"type":"integer","description":"Duration ms. Default: 500"},"start_at":{"type":"integer","description":"UTC epoch ms for scheduled playback. 0=now"}},"required":[]}

operation.name: listFiles
operation.parameter: List recorded video files on the device with sizes, timestamps, and transfer status.

operation.name: deleteFiles
operation.parameter: Delete recorded video files matching a glob pattern.

operation.name: sftpTransfer
operation.parameter: Transfer a video file to a remote storage server via SFTP with Ed25519 SSH key auth. Also transfers companion sidecar metadata.

operation.name: configure
operation.parameter: Configure camera recording settings. Changes take effect on next startRecording.

operation.name: cleanupFiles
operation.parameter: Clean up video files from the device based on policy: transferred files only, all files, or files older than a threshold.
